summary: All fourteen banner-matched findings rank High; the Python 3.12.10 API, Tomcat and the local model API sit behind no controls, and host-level matching pulls KEV-listed CVE-2020-0601 into the model API finding.

recommended_actions.action: Upgrade the Python runtime behind port 5000 and verify each matched 2025-2026 CVE applies to the running build
recommended_actions.reason: Ten vulners-matched CVEs from CVE-2025-12084 through CVE-2026-7210 were reported against Werkzeug httpd 2.2.3 with Python 3.12.10 on an unauthenticated, unencrypted endpoint.

recommended_actions.action: Front the Tomcat, WebWolf and model API services with a reverse proxy enforcing request timeouts and rate limiting
recommended_actions.reason: The slowloris checks on Tomcat 8888, WebWolf 9090 and the model API 11434 all report LIKELY VULNERABLE (CVE-2007-6750), and no rate limiting or WAF was observed on the host.

correlations.observation: F3, F5 and F8 are the same slowloris weakness (CVE-2007-6750) in three distinct services, so one mitigating reverse proxy addresses all three.

uncertainties: Vulners and CPE matches are banner-derived; applicability to the exact runtime build is unverified.
